page.layout: One column of running text, full measure. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre-left, page number at top right. Signature "B" and catchword "dam" at the foot.

main_text.p: orientis loca, in quæ Iudæos inde à tem-poribus Assyriacis avectos ac translatos in confessò est. II. Supponitur gratis fide-les ex Gentibus, vel παρεπιδήμους[?] potuisse dici, vel dispersione quâdam huc illuc per omnes illas Ponti, Galatiæ, Cappado-ciæ, Asiæ Provincias, Evangelij causâ fuisse disjectos. At qui παρεπίδημοι[?], qui agebant inter gentes, & patrias sedes oc-cupabant? Qui dispersionem passi, qui nonnisi recens admodum Christianæ fidei initiati esse poterant, qui gravissimâ cer-te in Christianos persecutione, ex aliis se-dibus huc delati esse debuissent? Qualis ante decimum Neronis annum, Petro jam sanè fini proximo, Christianis tum etiam suppliciis magis quàm exilio affli-ctis, nulla memoratur. παρεπιδήμους[?] alias pios omnes dixeris, sed metaphoricè & improprie, in ordine ad mundum in quo hospites, Hebr. xi.13. 1.Pet. ii.11. Tales verò hic dicti Petro proprie, certè in ordine ad Pontum, Galatiam, & regiones circumja-centes, adeoque soli Iudæi. Qui & exulum ac παροικων[?] nomen ut peculium quod-dam

page.notes: The Greek words (παρεπιδήμους, παρεπίδημοι, παροικων) are read from a small, smudged print and are marked [?]; the accents and letters may not be exact. The Roman numerals in the Hebrews and Peter references (xi.13, ii.11) are set in small type and may be misread. The first word "orientis" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The catchword "dam" is set at the right foot.
